status.description: done = task fully complete and verified; partial = some work done, remainder listed in notes; blocked = could not proceed, reason in notes; failed = attempted and abandoned.

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what was done and how it was verified.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths created, modified, or deleted. Empty for read-only tasks.

command.description: Exact command run, or empty string.

needs_escalation.description: True when the task turned out harder than its brief implied and a stronger model or a human should take over.

notes.description: Anything the orchestrator must know: remaining work, assumptions made, risks, questions for the user. Empty string if none.
